explication: Parcel is a zero-configuration web build tool. A user supplies project entries and build options; Parcel resolves dependencies, transforms assets, constructs bundles, packages and optimizes outputs, then reports results or serves them during development. Its plugin configuration selects resolvers, transformers, bundlers, namers, packagers, optimizers, compressors, and reporters. The graph combines documented product capabilities with source-index references and sampled calls; several plugin-stage links are documented or architectural, not verified in the sampled excerpts.
